title: docs(skills): a line-add action sets the price; a self-tied create gets a current_user default
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Ty2ru1KHBywrksCX6GQE13)_
Fixes #33978

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:两条搭建教学。① 界面技能 actions.md:「给父记录加明细行」的动作必须设置单价(从产品读价,或在角色可定价时设为必填参数),附一个可类型检查的示例;② 数据技能 security.md:插入策略的 `check` 绑定当前用户的字段时,给该字段设 `defaultValue: 'current_user'`,用户只说「加一个任务」也能建成。各配一条评测用例。
- 为什么改:评测里聊天写数据失败,6 次明细行金额写成空(加行动作没有价格),14 次建任务 403(策略要求用户没说的负责人)。维护者原话「聊天里改数据 出问题的关键还是我们的skills需要优化吧？」。
- 风险与回滚:仅技能文档、评测与 token 天花板,不改运行时;回滚即 revert。actions.md 天花板 2453→2808、security.md 3959→4041、objectstack-ui SKILL.md 3814→3833(先删重复,余额按实测提高)。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`(新段落与示例)→ `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`(`own_tasks` 策略与四行说明)→ `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`(两行天花板与算式)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 actions.md 显示 2808 / 2808、security.md 4041 / 4041,全部通过。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` § Action Parameter Patterns: **An action that adds a child line sets its price.** `lookupAutofill` fills only the form and the grid, and a stored `expression` reads only its own row, so a body inserting `invoice`, `product` and `quantity` alone stores no `amount`. Read the price from the source the build declares, or take it as a `required` param where the persona sets prices. One `os:check` example (`crm_add_invoice_line`, `type: 'script'`, params `product` and `quantity` borrowed with `objectOverride: 'invoice_line'`, a body with `api.read` + `api.write` that reads `product.list_price`, throws when the product is not found, and inserts the line; `refreshAfter: true`, since the invoice's roll-up total moves). Lines also written past the action (API, an agent, an import — one with automations off skips hooks) get the price from a `beforeInsert` hook on the line, `runAs: 'system'` when the writer cannot read it.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` § line-item grid behaviors: one clause scoping its "never add an 'Add line' button" to the grid, pointing a record-header action that inserts a priced line to rules/actions.md, so the two do not read as contradicting each other.
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` § Row-Level Security: the example's second policy becomes the insert-only `own_tasks` (`check: 'assignee == current_user.id'`, field `task.assignee: { type: 'user', defaultValue: 'current_user' }`), followed by four lines: a `check` over a field the request never names refuses a plain create; `defaultValue: 'current_user'` fills an omitted `user` field before `check` is judged.
- Homes, chosen by where a builder reads it: rule 1 where the add-line action and its params are written; rule 2 directly under the policy example, beside `check`. `relationships.md` and `field-types.md` untouched.
- Paid down first (standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, record 6513306068), each cut keeping a home:
  - actions.md, 85 bytes: "`locations` is an array of surfaces:" (the H2 names `locations`, the table header says Surface); the `opensInNewTab` H3 tail "— async / computed redirect" (its paragraph opens "A redirect URL computed after a fetch"); ", holes in either" on the `helpText` bullet (the bullet above lists `description` and a param's `helpText` among the `{{ }}` copy holes).
  - security.md, 137 bytes: the `org_isolation` example policy. A select-only `using` policy is still shown twice in § Membership keys; `current_user.organization_id` keeps its placeholder-table row; the tenant predicate is the Layer 0 wall in § Platform-global objects.
- Evals: `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` case 18 (the add-line action); `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 21 (the self-tied create; it follows case 20, which #33954 landed, byte-identical after the merge of main). Every `must_contain` appears verbatim in its `expected_output`; both `must_not_contain` lists are empty.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: three rows moved to the measurement (actions.md, security.md, objectstack-ui SKILL.md), arithmetic in the row comments. The review-round additions (35 + 24 tokens) had no true duplicate to cut, so they rest on the ruling's second half.
- `.changeset/33978-line-price-and-self-tied-create.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.
- No forced test edits.

## Tests

Measured on `origin/main` before writing (b8ac0e24):

- `defaultValue: 'current_user'` is a runtime token on a `user` field (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, the `defaultValue` describe), resolved per request in `packages/objectql/src/engine-defaults-and-autonumbers.ts`.
- On insert the engine applies field defaults, then `beforeInsert` hooks, and the RLS `check` judges that post-hook row (`postHookWriteImageCheck`; pinned by `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/insert-check-post-image.test.ts`).
- A CEL `defaultValue` envelope and a stored `expression` read only the row being written, so neither can read the product's price; `lookupAutofill` is client-side only.
- Action bodies run elevated (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`, `isSystem: true`); hooks run as the operator unless `runAs: 'system'` (`packages/objectql/src/hook-run-as.ts`).

<details><summary>Scratch proof (uncommitted vitest file on the insert-check-post-image harness, deleted after) — 5/5 passed</summary>

```text
assignee: { type: 'user', defaultValue: 'current_user' } + insert check 'assignee == current_user.id'
  create naming no assignee            -> admitted, stored assignee = the caller
  control: same field, no default      -> PERMISSION_DENIED 403 "the insert would violate a row-level CHECK"
  with the default, naming another user -> still 403
  the taught field parses through ObjectSchema.create
invoice_line amount = record.quantity * record.unit_price
  quantity 3, no unit_price            -> amount null (not 0)
  quantity 3, unit_price 20            -> amount 60
Lock VERDICT command-exit 0 · Test Files 1 passed · Tests 5 passed
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Not taught: the card's alternative for rule 2, "say in the field description that an agent sets it". On main the agent's object description (`describeServedObject`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) serves name, type, label, required, readonly, system, options and `defaultValue` per field, and no `description`, so that route has no measured agent consumer. It does serve `defaultValue` and tells the agent to omit the field to get it, which is the taught path.
- The rule 1 example computes the price and takes no price param: the body runs elevated, so an optional override param would let a persona write a price their field grant denies. The param route stays prose ("a `required` param where the persona sets prices").
- NOT MEASURED: the example action run through the action runtime (it is type-checked; its mechanics follow the file's existing script example); a hook stamping `unit_price` for a persona whose field grant denies editing it (the text makes no claim about it).
- `field-types.md`'s `lookupAutofill` paragraph still ends at "Client-side only" with no pointer to the new rule; left out to keep to two rule files.
- Review round (seat at-tier review PASS at 31a2d6d4, record 6897741755): N2, N3, N4 applied in one commit; N1 and N5 left as they are.
- Authoring arrangement: this thread is served below the card's mandated tier, so the `skills/**` text was authored and committed by an at-tier (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`) subagent in the same worktree and branch; push, gates, relay writes and the report stay with the thread.

- `--ran` reconciliation: "65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". The union at the previous heads read the same (63 derived, 62 run, 1 NOT MEASURED at both `18e323b` and `31a2d6d`).
